title: Video Shows a San Diego Dog Seeming to Greet an Intruder. Why Didn’t He Bark?
description: Dog behavior experts offered a variety of explanations for why Nash the golden retriever wagged his tail and carried a toy near a man who broke into his owner’s home.
author: Michael Levenson

title: Trump Has Tried to Ban Reporters From Government Spaces Before
description: There are several instances where the president made an effort to stifle the work of journalists.
author: Erik Wemple and Michael M. Grynbaum

title: How Trump’s Trade War Could Hurt Republican Efforts to Hold the Senate
description: In a handful of border states and industrial states that could decide Senate control, the president’s standoff with Canada has drawn criticism from voters, including some who supported him in 2024.
author: Tim Balk, Oralandar Brand-Williams and Jesse Ellison

title: Sherrod Brown Tries a New Retort to Criticism on Transgender Issues
description: A spot from the Senate candidate in Ohio seeks to dismiss the Republican Party’s focus on transgender rights as a distraction from economic issues.
author: Emily Davies

title: Man Charged in Maryland Boy’s Disappearance After 33 Years
description: A 61-year-old man has been charged with murder in the death of 10-year-old George Burdynski Jr., whose case shocked a Maryland neighborhood.
author: Ishani Desai

title: Tracking Assault Weapons Bans Across the Country as Court Battles Continue
description: Here are the states that have sought to limit access to some of the most lethal firearms, as gun restrictions face new legal challenges.
author: Aishvarya Kavi

title: After North Carolina’s Gerrymander, Democrat Don Davis Trumpets His Centrism in 1st District
description: Representative Don Davis is seeking re-election in a district redrawn by state lawmakers to lean more Republican.
author: Olivia Diaz

title: Texas Billionaire John Poindexter Plans to Revive Shafter Ghost Town
description: An 81-year-old billionaire has a vision for preserving a tiny West Texas mining town, even as other forces are reshaping the land around it.
author: Sasha von Oldershausen and Christopher Lee

title: Kennedy Center Supporters Rally Amid Fears of Trump’s Demolition
description: Photos of President Trump reviewing a poster board with the title “Kennedy Center DEMOLISHED” spurred the largest gathering yet in support of the performing arts institution.
author: Chris Cameron

title: Air Force Officer Charged After Protesting Trump Says He Spoke to Defend Constitution
description: Major Jason Watson could face court-martial in what could become a rare test of a service member’s right to publicly dissent.
author: Anushka Patil

title: F.A.A. Safety Request for the Top of Trump’s Arch: Eternal Fire
description: The aviation agency deemed the mammoth arch safe for air travel if it includes a constant flame and other safety measures to help make it visible to planes.
author: Luke Broadwater

title: U.S. and Denmark Reach Security Deal on Greenland, Trump Says
description: The full contours of the deal were unclear, but Denmark and Greenland both indicated they expected an agreement to be signed soon.
author: Zolan Kanno-Youngs, Jeffrey Gettleman and Anton Troianovski

title: Appeals Court Restricts Trump Administration Deportation Effort
description: The ruling allows migrants to contest deportations to countries other than their place of origin. The case could head to the Supreme Court.
author: Mattathias Schwartz

title: Republicans Are Now the ‘Elitist’ Party, Voters Say
description: We spoke to independents who have soured on Trump.
author: Jess Bidgood

title: Russia Aims to Inject Chaos Into Elections, U.S. Intelligence Finds
description: The Kremlin is once again seeking to undermine confidence in American democracy with online influence campaigns, U.S. officials said.
author: Dustin Volz, Julian E. Barnes and Steven Lee Myers

title: St. Paul Mayor’s Behavior Faulted After Police Chief’s Complaint
description: An outside investigation found that Mayor Kaohly Her had engaged in offensive behavior, but found no evidence that she sexually harassed colleagues. It did find that she had engaged in “offensive” behavior.
author: Ernesto Londoño

title: F.A.A. to Roll Out New A.I. Tool for Washington Airports
description: The tool, called SMART, will crunch scheduling and weather data to predict and avoid delays. It will be deployed in the Washington region’s three major airports next week.
author: Aishvarya Kavi and Karoun Demirjian

title: Cost of Iran War Estimated at $43.6 Billion
description: For the first time, the Pentagon reported costs incurred by each armed service. The figures are almost certainly on the low side, congressional officials said.
author: Eric Schmitt

title: Judge Who Struck Down Trump’s Compensation Fund Asks: Will Trump Just Pay Allies Another Way?
description: The question was raised at a court hearing by a federal judge who has already barred the fund from moving forward.
author: Alan Feuer

title: Trump Courts North Korea’s Leader, but Might Need China to Reignite the Flame
description: President Trump has gotten no love back yet from Kim Jong-un. He could turn to Xi Jinping, China’s leader, to help set up a summit when Mr. Xi visits Washington next week.
author: Edward Wong
